Free developer tools that run in your browser

DevTools Forge is a free suite of developer tools that run entirely in your browser. Merge PDFs, format and validate JSON, and convert between data formats without uploading a single file and without creating an account. Everything runs locally, so your data never leaves your machine.

Open the PDF merge tool

What DevTools Forge does

DevTools Forge gives you a set of focused, single-purpose tools. The PDF merge tool combines several PDF files into one in the order you choose. The JSON formatter pretty-prints and validates JSON and reports the line and column of the first syntax error. Each tool loads in under a second and works offline once the page has loaded, because the processing happens in your browser.

Who it is for

DevTools Forge is built for developers, analysts and writers who need a quick, private, no-login way to fix a file and get back to work. There is nothing to install and nothing to sign up for to use any of the free tools.
